outcome.technical: tests/test_build_shop.py only. esc47's single assertion (exit 3 with 'own repository') is replaced by a block of its own, '# --- the own-repository check, on every git ---': esc47 (every host, the host's git) asserts the patch's anchor matched once, the GIT_DIR-keeping builder did not exit 0, its exit is one of the builder's documented failures (2 or 3), and the other repository is unchanged unless the own-repository check refused the build - on macOS the patched builder commits into the other repository before the check can ask, which this host showed, so an unconditional 'unchanged' would be false here. esc57 (the reached half) asserts exit 3 with 'does not hold its own repository' when check_reached() says the check was reached; check_reached() is False only for the builder's could-not-build exit with a 'build-shop: git init|add|commit failed' line, so an exit 0 always counts as reached and fails. Where git stopped first, esc57 goes through _harness.skip() and prints 'esc57 ... SKIPPED HERE - the own-repository check was not reached on this host: git stopped the patched builder first (exit 2: <git's words>)'. esc59 writes a substitute `git` into a mkdtemp the case removes in finally, puts it ahead of PATH for the builder only (the repository readings around it use the host's git), and asserts esc47's faults are empty, the windows words reached the build's stderr, and check_reached() says not reached. esc58 patches built() to ask its question from a subdirectory of a second repository it makes inside the workspace, with no GIT_DIR anywhere, and asserts exit 3 with its words, the workspace holding its own repository, and check_reached() True. Suite: 63 cases before, 66 after; sweep seconds 19.7 before, 16.5 and 18.1 after (two runs about five minutes apart, other sessions loading the machine), 14.1 under --encoding cp1252. The orchestrator's gate (run-test-gate.py SG2 --task SG2.6-xk1, not recorded) printed GATE GREEN, exit 0. ruff, vermin -t=3.8-, prose_number_claims and house_style_violations report nothing for the file. Dependants: plugins/audit/evals/bugfix/case.yaml and guard-stop/case.yaml are still read the same way (no reader changed); tests/test__output_lints.py uses _cases and _selftest, whose names and signatures are unchanged; CHANGELOG.md and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md describe the builder's refusal (exit 3) and what the suite builds, both still true since the builder is unchanged and no case id, count or wording they cite was touched. Windows-only: whether esc57 prints the not-reached line or the reached half on a windows runner, and that esc58 and esc59 pass there (the substitute git is a POSIX sh script found by MSYS sh the way the suite's python3 wrapper already is), can only be confirmed by a windows run.
outcome.descriptive: The eval builder's own-repository refusal is now held on every host: esc47 asserts what must never happen, esc57 asserts the check where git lets the patched builder reach it and prints a not-reached line where git stops first, esc59 drives that windows path here with a substituted git, and esc58 holds the check without GIT_DIR.
